notes.title: DEMO'S OUT! 8-player mayhem, Gator, & new blocks until Aug 18
notes.content:
[h2]From now until [b]August 18[/b], you can play the [b]free demo[/b] for Ultimate Sheep Raccoon![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923350/Ultimate_Sheep_Raccoon/ Now's your chance to check out the first-ever 8-player chaos, plus meet our jawsome new racer, Gator. We’ve also packed in tons of gameplay updates, so grab your friends and get racing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/3b90fff67ec9e0b02ef098eeb0fc7c6ef3cf34bd.png[/img]
[h2]What's new in the demo?[/h2] 
[list][*][b]8-player support[/b]: For the first time! 
[*][b]New core gameplay[/b]: Start each match in open levels and build the terrain before racing!
[*][b]Updated levels[/b]: Farm, Scrapyard, and Docks are back with refreshed designs, plus a Test Level we'd love your feedback on.
[*][b]6 playable characters 🐊[/b]: Introducing our new competitor, Gator, plus the 5 other animals including Monkey, Chicken, Horse, Sheep, and Raccoon.
[*][b]New blocks[/b]: Try out the frog hookshot 🐸 and fireworks box 🎆
[*][b]Double party box[/b]: When there are 2 players, you get 2 sets of blocks to choose from to help fill up the level.
[*][b]Alternate control schemes[/b]: Swap between two different sets of controls, see which suits you best.
[*][b]Improved clarity[/b]: Better power-up visuals, clearer tutorials, and a new tutorial system. [/list] And as a thank-you for playing the demo, you'll unlock an [b]exclusive in-game reward[/b] when Ultimate Sheep Raccoon officially releases!

A little reminder: This is just a slice of what’s coming – more levels, more characters, and the custom level builder are still on the way. Thanks for racing with us while we keep improving Ultimate Sheep Raccoon together.

[h2]Help us make the game better[/h2]
Found a bug? Have feedback? Press F1 in-game or fill out our [url=https://form.typeform.com/to/NlALSflq]feedback form[/url] to let us know. We read every single message and your input directly shapes the final game.

Check out our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2923350/discussions/0/598534669681785748/]Steam FAQ thread[/url] for answers to common questions, or hop into the [url=https://discord.gg/UCH]Clever Endeavour Games Discord[/url] to chat with the devs and find other people to play with. 

[h2]Ultimate Merch[/h2]
We've also got some Ultimate Sheep Raccoon merch to grab! It includes a colorful sticker sheet and a comic strip t-shirt of your fave animals.

You can grab them both on [url=https://theyetee.com/collections/ultimate-sheep-raccoon]The Yetee[/url].
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/fc8bc79391c023c95fa5cc0a882f58ec62e83338.jpg[/img]
That's it from us! 

See you... [i]at the finish line![/i]
- Your friends at Clever Endeavour Games

notes.title: Upcoming demo with Gator and 8-player support! 🐊 August 15-18
notes.content:
Hey there! We've got a new [b]free demo[/b] for Ultimate Sheep Raccoon available this weekend, [b]August 15-18![/b] 🚲

This is the first time we're unleashing 8-player support, so enjoy the chaos! We've also added our jaw-some new animal, Gator. 🐊

The demo goes live [b]August 15 at 10AM Eastern.[/b] 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/390204bb3d0db892aec40a6ddb0626db7e6bc306.jpg"][/img]
[h2]What's new?[/h2] 
[list][*][b]8-player support[/b]: For the first time! 
[*][b]New core gameplay[/b]: Start each match in open levels and build the terrain before racing!
[*][b]Updated levels[/b]: Farm, Scrapyard, and Docks are back with refreshed designs, plus a Test Level we'd love your feedback on.
[*][b]6 playable characters 🐊[/b]: Introducing our new animal, Gator, plus the other 5 critters including Monkey, Chicken, Horse, Sheep, and Raccoon.
[*][b]New blocks[/b]: Try out the frog hookshot 🐸 and fireworks box 🎆
[*][b]Double party box[/b]: When there are 2 players, you get 2 sets of blocks to choose from to help fill up the level.
[*][b]Alternate control schemes[/b]: Swap between two different sets of controls, see which suits you best.
[*][b]Improved clarity[/b]: Better power-up visuals, clearer tutorials, and a new tutorial system. [/list] We'd love to get your help with bug reports and feedback on the demo. You can either press "F1" in game, or go to [url="https://form.typeform.com/to/NlALSflq"]the form here[/url] to leave feedback. We read through every single response, so your message actively helps us. 

Also, a little reminder: This demo is just a look at the final game. We’re still cooking up more levels, characters, and the custom level builder - so thanks for racing and joining the party with us while we make an awesome game together. 

[h2]Answering your questions[/h2]
We know you have a lot of questions, and we'd like to answer them! We've made a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2923350/discussions/0/598534669681785748/]Steam discussion here[/url] where we cover a lot of the frequently asked questions and concerns the community has shared with us. If you have a question, feel free to post there.

We want to hear from you guys and to let you know we hear you. We're actively incorporating your feedback into Ultimate Sheep Raccoon. 

Also, join us on the [url=http://discord.gg/UCH]Clever Endeavour Games Discord[/url] for all things Sheep and Raccoon.

[url=http://discord.gg/UCH][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/ed6d5b605d7805256a0fc8c609e568a19c84cc4e.gif[/img]
[/url]See you later, alligator!

notes.title: NEW DEMO! Monkey around in Ultimate Sheep Raccoon (May 8-11)
notes.content:
[h2]Monkey around in the FREE DEMO for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923350/Ultimate_Sheep_Raccoon/]Ultimate Sheep Raccoon[/url] until May 11![/h2]
Go to the store page and click the green "demo" button to play. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923350/Ultimate_Sheep_Raccoon/
What's in the latest demo? 
[list][*] New playable character, [b]Monkey[/b] 🍌
[*] New race track, [b]Docks[/b] (plus the original Farm and Scrapyard levels)
[*] Local and online multiplayer for up to 4 players on Steam
[*] A variety of blocks, power-ups, and tricks to experiment with
[*] And as thank-you for playing the demo, [i]you'll unlock an exclusive in-game reward when Ultimate Sheep Raccoon officially releases[/i][/list] 
We've also made loads of changes since our last public demo:
[list][*] Improved bike physics and controls for smoother rides
[*] Improved how the camera follows players, and the camera no longer punishes you for going off-screen. Instead, it launches you back into the action
[*] Introduced private lobbies, lobby codes, Steam invites, and custom player counts (2-4 max). 
[*] Increased points required to win, giving you more rounds to play and experiment with power-ups
[*] New alternate control scheme: [i]Trials[/i] style controls (use RT and LT to move), selectable from the main menu options
[*] Bunch of new art
[*] Miscellaneous bug fixes and improvements [/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/9adbc8abfc3ef618cdcf8e1175c12016a3e428be.jpg[/img]
Also, a little reminder that this demo is only a look at some of the content that will be in the final game. We're still working on big features like [i]8-player support, the custom level editor, and more characters[/i] - thanks for being so patient with us! 

Your feedback helps us improve and shape Ultimate Sheep Raccoon, so we want hear from you! You can leave feedback in-game by pressing F1, or share your ideas/suggestions in the [url=discord.gg/UCH]Clever Endeavour Game Discord[/url].

And if you won’t have to chance to play the demo this weekend, join the Discord to be notified when future playtests are available. (And there WILL be more!)

[h2]Merch for Ultimate Sheep Raccoon[/h2]
We also just launched our first [b][url=https://theyetee.com/collections/ultimate-sheep-raccoon]Ultimate Sheep Raccoon merch collection[/url][/b] on The Yetee! 🚲

Grab the [url=https://theyetee.com/collections/ultimate-sheep-raccoon/products/ultimate-bike-rider]Ultimate Bike Rider T-shirt[/url] and [url=https://theyetee.com/collections/ultimate-sheep-raccoon/products/bike-decals]Bike Decals[/url] now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/fc8bc79391c023c95fa5cc0a882f58ec62e83338.jpg[/img]
[h2]PAX East 2025[/h2]
The Clever Endeavour team is at PAX East, right now, showing Ultimate Sheep Raccoon. Come say hi! 

We're at [b]Booth 17093[/b]. Race the devs in person and get some swag - including the new Yetee merch! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/4c03d8f24cbe341eeeb90b97e9867c75e2cb1e39.jpg[/img]
OOO EEE AAHH OOO ("Happy racing!")
- The Clever Endeavour Team

notes.title: Announcing Monkey and another free demo! May 8-11!
notes.content:
OOO EEE AHHH OOH. Get ready to go bananas and play as [b]Monkey[/b] in another FREE demo of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923350/Ultimate_Sheep_Raccoon/]Ultimate Sheep Raccoon[/url], available from [b]May 8-11[/b] on Steam! 🍌

The demo goes live at 12:30 PM Eastern on May 8 and closes around 11 PM Eastern on May 11.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/b3f1531312852f8f59614df76fc17ee03dce210c.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923350/Ultimate_Sheep_Raccoon/][b]Ultimate Sheep Raccoon[/b][/url] is a bike-racing party game where you and your friends build a course of ramps, obstacles, and traps! Dodge hazards, do crazy tricks, and use power-ups to get ahead of the competition.

What's in the latest demo? 
[list][*] New playable character, [b]Monkey[/b]
[*] New race track, [b]Docks[/b] (plus the original Farm and Scrapyard levels)
[*] Local and online multiplayer for up to 4 players on Steam
[*] A variety of blocks, power-ups, and tricks to experiment with[/list] 
We've made loads of changes since our last public demo:
[list][*] Improved bike physics and controls for smoother rides
[*] Improved how the camera follows players, and the camera no longer punishes you for going off-screen. Instead, it launches you back into the action
[*] Introduced private lobbies, lobby codes, Steam invites, and custom player counts (2-4 max). 
[*] Increased points required to win, giving you more rounds to play and experiment with power-ups
[*] New alternate control scheme: [i]Trials[/i] style controls (use RT and LT to move), selectable from the main menu options
[*] Bunch of new art
[*] Miscellaneous bug fixes and improvements [/list] 
Also, a little reminder that this demo is only a look at some of the content that will be in the final game. We're still working on big features like [i]8-player support, the custom level editor, and more characters[/i] - thanks for being so patient with us! 

[h2]PAX East 2025[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/4c03d8f24cbe341eeeb90b97e9867c75e2cb1e39.jpg[/img]

[url=discord.gg/UCH][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/ed6d5b605d7805256a0fc8c609e568a19c84cc4e.gif[/img][/url]
We want to see your ideas and feedback! So please share them with us on the [url=discord.gg/UCH]Clever Endeavour Games Discord[/url].

Stay tuned for the demo launching May 8, and please wishlist Ultimate Sheep Raccoon on Steam! We can't wait to see you on the track soon. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923350/Ultimate_Sheep_Raccoon/
And if you're unable to play this time, join the Discord to hear about future playtests!

The demo goes live at [b]2 PM UTC / 9 AM Eastern[/b]! 

Ultimate Sheep Raccoon is a bike-racing party game where you and your friends build the course together and race to the finish line. It’s like a spiritual successor to Ultimate Chicken Horse, and it absolutely has the same chaotic hilarious party shenanigans. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/b66d2b2c915f7168a614a108e637404f79b22f4e.jpg[/img]

[*]Blocks, power-ups, and tricks to play with
[*]Four favourite characters to choose from: Sheep, Raccoon, Chicken, and Horse[/list] While our full release will have even more features - including 8-player support, the custom level editor, and new playable characters - we’ve packed the demo with lots of racing action, and we’re super eager to hear your thoughts. 

Player feedback early on is very important for our game development process. So if you’d like to share your ideas or suggestions with us, please join the [url=discord.gg/UCH]Ultimate Sheep Raccoon Discord[/url].

[/url]
Stay tuned for the demo on February 21, and please wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923350/Ultimate_Sheep_Raccoon/]Ultimate Sheep Raccoon[/url]! We can’t wait for you to join us on the track later this week! (And if you're not able to play the demo this time, join the Discord to be notified of future playtests.)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923350/Ultimate_Sheep_Raccoon/

notes.title: Announcing Ultimate Sheep Raccoon - our new game!
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing our brand new game,[/h1]
[h1][b][i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923350/Ultimate_Sheep_Raccoon/]Ultimate Sheep Raccoon[/url][/i][/b]! 🐑 🦝[/h1] 

Hitting the track in 2025!

[previewyoutube=J4hC8GudgBU;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Ultimate Sheep Raccoon[/b] is a bike-racing party game where you and your friends build a course of ramps, obstacles, and traps! Dodge hazards, do crazy tricks, and use power-ups to get ahead of the competition. You can play with up to 8 players locally, online, and cross-platform. 

[h1]Wishlist now![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923350/Ultimate_Sheep_Raccoon/

Ultimate Sheep Raccoon is a spiritual successor to Ultimate Chicken Horse - not a sequel! It's got the same party spirit with a ton of new things to do. 

Stay tuned for future playtests where you can play with us ahead of release! 
Follow our socials if you're interested: 

[url=https://discord.gg/UCH]Discord[/url] | [url=https://x.com/ClevEndeavGames]X[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/clevendeavgames.bsky.social]BlueSky[/url] | [url=https://www.instagram.com/clevendeavgames/]Instagram [/url] | [url=http://www.ultimatesheepraccoon.com/]Website (and newsletter!)[/url]

[h1]A big thank you from us[/h1]
When Ultimate Chicken Horse first came out (over 8 years ago), we never could have imagined it taking off the way it did. Our silly game jam project grew into a massive party hit that people play across the world and across generations. That's special. And UCH's success has allowed us to keep working in that party game space and create [b]Ultimate Sheep Raccoon[/b] - our next step for awesome times together with friends and families! 

We seriously can't wait to get it in front of you! 🚲

See you very soon,
Clever Endeavour Games

[h1]Join The Race[/h1]
Keep up to date with all things Ultimate Sheep Raccoon by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/UCH]Discord[/url]! We're planning community playtests and we're always looking for more players to help us test and improve the game leading up to its release.
